origin: Root origin is socket_grip_r; source axes are normalized to Blender +Z up/-Y forward so Blender export_yup produces runtime Y-up/+Z-forward sockets.

socket_notes.socket_muzzle: Center of actual Cylinder.010 foremost ring (raw max Z within .1mm); previous marker pointed at stock Plane.024.
socket_notes.socket_grip_r: Physical Plane.010 upper pistol grip, raw midpoint (.0343649946,.0247771684,-.082)m; behind and immediately below the trigger. Plane.012 lower extension is not the firing grip.
socket_notes.socket_grip_l: Physical Plane.003 forward underside at raw (-.0036042801,.0247771684,+.13)m; .212m ahead of firing grip, .0918751m behind physical muzzle.
socket_notes.socket_eject: Legacy provisional ejection proposal; actual port/direction is not visually or physically accepted.
socket_notes.socket_vfx: Muzzle flash/tracer fallback, intentionally colocated with socket_muzzle.
